mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MACRO_STATE WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MACRO_STATE(thread_id, growth, inflation, labor, fed, liquidity, rates, dollar, risk, version, updated_at) VALUES(#{threadId}, #{growth}, #{inflation}, #{labor}, #{fed}, #{liquidity}, #{rates}, #{dollar}, #{risk}, #{version}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO MACRO_ANALYSIS(turn_id, thread_id, result_json, changes_json, summary, state_version, created_at) VALUES(#{turnId}, #{threadId}, #{resultJson}, #{changesJson}, #{summary}, #{stateVersion}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MACRO_ANALYSIS WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM MACRO_ANALYSIS WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND changes_json != '{}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MACRO_RELEASE(release_id, indicator, period, release_date, payload_json, created_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{indicator}, #{period}, #{date}, #{json}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT payload_json FROM MACRO_RELEASE WHERE release_id = #{id}
